source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Spend 1 CP in the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase) as an enemy unit picks a **KILLER** unit of yours as its target; that unit is the target.

Whenever a **KILLER** model in it is **destroyed** while the unit has not yet been **selected to fight** in this phase, roll a D6:

- On a 1, 1 **[mortal wound](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)** is dealt to the attacking enemy unit.
- On a 2+, leave the model on the battlefield; remove it after the unit has fought or when the phase ends, whichever comes first.
